sources.officialOwner: Los Angeles County Assessor, Auditor-Controller, Treasurer and Tax Collector, Assessment Appeals Board
sources.sourceName: Los Angeles County Property Tax Portal and Assessor Property Search
sources.runtimeUse: Resolve APN/AIN and retrieve current bill/payment/tax-detail facts after parcel identification or tax bill upload.
limitations: Tax amount lookup requires Assessor Identification Number for the treasurer workflow.
Lookup data is not a bulk official rate import for all parcels.
Exemptions, direct assessments, and parcel-specific levy detail should come from tax bill/assessor records.
sources.evidenceText: County property tax portal is run by Assessor, Auditor-Controller, Treasurer and Tax Collector, and Assessment Appeals Board; current secured taxes are looked up with AIN.

sources.officialOwner: City of Los Angeles Office of Finance
sources.sourceName: Los Angeles Business Tax Information Booklet / Know Your Rates
sources.runtimeUse: Source-backed rates by classification can power estimates only after address-in-city, classification, gross receipts, and apportionment are supplied.
limitations: Address alone cannot determine taxable gross receipts or business classification.
Multiple classifications, exemptions, and apportionment require tax return/accountant facts.
Annual renewal timing and city rulings can affect final liability.
sources.evidenceText: Los Angeles states most business taxes are based on gross receipts at rates per $1,000; city pages publish classification-specific rates such as retail sales and services.

sources.sourceName: Vernon Licenses & Permits / Doing Business in Vernon
sources.runtimeUse: Flag Vernon warehouse/distribution properties for tax-bill upload or city confirmation of special parcel tax.
limitations: City says current special parcel tax rate should be checked with the City.
Applies to specific facility categories, not all businesses.
Collected through property tax bill, so bill lines are needed.
sources.evidenceText: Vernon states it has a Special Parcel Tax assessment on non-refrigerated warehouses, truck terminals, freight terminals, and distribution facilities, collected through the property tax bill.

sources.officialOwner: San Diego County Treasurer-Tax Collector; Assessor/Recorder/County Clerk; Auditor and Controller Property Tax Services
sources.sourceName: San Diego County property bill, APN, and special assessment lookup sources
sources.runtimeUse: After APN/tax bill upload, retrieve bill, assessed valuation, tax rates, and special assessment breakdown.
limitations: Assessor records route through ParcelQuest and value-notice searches rather than a public bulk feed.
Special assessment lookup requires secured tax parcel number.
Not suitable for estimating parcel taxes from ZIP/city alone.
sources.evidenceText: Treasurer-Tax Collector supports bill search by parcel/bill number, mailing address, or unsecured bill number; special assessment lookup returns assessed valuation, tax rates, and Mello-Roos/CFD breakdown by secured parcel.

sources.officialOwner: City of San Diego Office of the City Treasurer
sources.runtimeUse: Estimate annual certificate fees after location, employee count, and business category are supplied.
limitations: Address plus NAICS is not enough for final certificate fee.
Late fees and rental-unit business tax require account and filing facts.
Portal is a filing/lookup workflow, not a bulk local business tax dataset.
sources.evidenceText: City requires all businesses operating in San Diego to obtain a Business Tax Certificate; application fee examples include base business tax, SB-1186 fee, and employee-based minimum wage enforcement fee.

sources.officialOwner: Orange County Assessor Department; Orange County Treasurer-Tax Collector
sources.sourceName: Orange County property value and tax bill lookup
sources.runtimeUse: Resolve APN/address and verify assessed value/tax bill lines after parcel match.
limitations: Owner search is restricted.
Tax bill contains value and tax lines but should be treated as parcel-specific evidence.
No confirmed bulk adapter from official pages.
sources.evidenceText: Orange County Assessor provides secured property value information online; Treasurer tax bill search supports property address, parcel number/APN, tax lien number, and other identifiers.

sources.sourceName: Anaheim Business License and Municipal Code license-tax provisions
sources.runtimeUse: For known business class and employee count, calculate ordinance-based license-tax components.
limitations: Business-class mapping from NAICS is not safe without user confirmation.
Regulated activities can require extra permits/fees.
No unified official machine-readable rate file identified.
sources.evidenceText: Anaheim code section 3.16.010 sets a services license tax as a flat amount plus an amount for each employee; city pages provide business license workflow.

sources.sourceName: King County Parcel Viewer and property tax payment/search
sources.runtimeUse: Use address to find parcel and link to assessor/tax reports; block final calculation until parcel tax statement or official parcel tax data is captured.
limitations: Seattle does not collect property tax; county property system controls land/building tax lookup.
Parcel Viewer is an interactive map, not a guaranteed bulk tax-detail API.
Levy and exemptions remain parcel/year-specific.
sources.evidenceText: King County Parcel Viewer supports search by address or parcel and links to Assessor eReal Property reports; Seattle directs property tax users to King County.

sources.sourceName: Seattle Business License Tax / B&O tax
sources.runtimeUse: City B&O source can drive estimates after Seattle activity, classification, gross receipts, and deductions are supplied.
limitations: Seattle B&O is separate from Washington state B&O.
Address alone cannot determine gross income attributable to Seattle.
FileLocal/accountant facts are needed for filed liability and deductions.
sources.evidenceText: Seattle states its business license tax/B&O tax applies to gross income and varies by business type; Washington DOR states local B&O is administered by cities, not DOR.

sources.officialOwner: City of Detroit Office of the Assessor; City Treasurer; Wayne County Treasurer
sources.sourceName: Detroit assessor and Wayne County delinquent property tax systems
sources.runtimeUse: Use as parcel/tax-status source for Detroit property tax workflows; require city tax bill for current detailed line-item calculation.
limitations: Wayne County site is delinquent-tax focused; current Detroit taxes may require city treasurer/assessor systems.
Wayne County directs users to local communities for current assessment data and tax parcel maps.
RERZ/abatement calculations need approved project/zone documents and actual eligible tax lines.
sources.evidenceText: Wayne County delinquent tax system supports lookup by parcel ID or street address and city; Detroit Assessor values real and tangible personal property for levied taxes.

sources.officialOwner: City of Detroit; Michigan Department of Treasury City Tax Administration
sources.sourceName: Detroit business income tax and city withholding guidance
sources.runtimeUse: Can source rates/forms and route Detroit entities to accountant-input workflow; not safe for address-only estimates.
limitations: Tax base is income/apportionment based, not derivable from address.
Partnership partner status and corporation/entity classification matter.
Withholding obligations require payroll and employee work-location facts.
sources.evidenceText: Detroit publishes business income tax rates including 2.00% for businesses and partner-rate distinctions; 2026 withholding guide requires employers doing business in Detroit to withhold.

sources.officialOwner: Washtenaw County Treasurer; City of Ann Arbor Assessing and Treasury
sources.sourceName: Washtenaw property/parcel lookup and Ann Arbor tax payment
sources.runtimeUse: Resolve parcel and assessment/tax payment facts for Zingerman's-like Ann Arbor cases; require bill upload for final tax lines.
limitations: Ann Arbor payment search requires parcel number and last name.
County parcel lookup combines county treasury/equalization data but is lookup-oriented.
No city income/business tax source verified for Ann Arbor.
sources.evidenceText: Washtenaw property/parcel lookup combines current real property data from the Treasurer and Equalization/Property Description; Ann Arbor online tax payments search by parcel number and last name.

sources.officialOwner: Grant County Assessor; Grant County Treasurer
sources.sourceName: Grant County property search and tax statements
sources.runtimeUse: Support parcel/tax statement retrieval for Quincy data-center workflow after parcel/account match.
limitations: Treasurer statement search is lookup-oriented and owner-name/property-ID dependent.
No verified bulk parcel-tax line import.
Local B&O status for Quincy remains unresolved.
sources.evidenceText: Grant County property search accepts parcel/property search terms; Treasurer page supports searching 2025 and 2026 tax statements by property ID, parcel number, or exact owner name.

sources.sourceName: Snohomish County property taxes, SCOPI map, and treasurer search
sources.runtimeUse: Parcel and tax-bill lookup for Everett industrial property workflows.
limitations: SCOPI is an interactive map; production adapter needs terms/API confirmation.
Final tax amount and exemptions remain parcel/year specific.
Business personal property listing is a separate workflow.
sources.evidenceText: Snohomish County Assessor provides property information, exemptions, and SCOPI mapping; county states assessor and treasurer use the same software for value and taxes due.

gaps.gapDescription: Need official municipal adoption/waiver/assessment treatment for renewable energy property/tangible tax beyond statewide constants.

gaps.jurisdiction: Detroit / Wayne County / Michigan RERZ local units
gaps.gapDescription: RERZ-style benefit cannot be calculated from geography alone; need approved zone boundary, local-unit certificate/approval, parcel inclusion, eligible tax-line treatment, and actual tax bill evidence.
Official city-level B&O applicability/rates for Everett and Quincy were not proven from official city sources during this pass.

City business license taxes are official but classification/employee/square-foot or special business facts are needed; no normalized machine-readable current rate table was found for all sample cities.

gaps.jurisdiction: Priority counties in CA, WA, MI
gaps.gapDescription: Most county sources are official lookup/GIS portals. Production bulk adapters need API/licensing/terms confirmation before automated ingestion.
